params.message:
Read a reasoning model's chunked answer as text, and give an eval batch five minutes

Two faults in the balanced gold-set run of 2026-10-10:

- Mistral sends a reasoning model's answer (GLM 5.3) as a list of chunks, a
  thinking chunk and then text chunks. callOpenAICompat passed that list on as
  the answer, and eval-models crashed on it. messageText keeps the text chunks
  only; a plain string is unchanged.
- Haiku 4.5 needs up to 114 s for a batch of ten, and two of its batches were
  killed at the eval's 120 s limit, so it was scored on 80 signals while the
  other models had 100. The limit is now 300 s; speed stays in the latency
  column.
